_comment: Tunable thresholds for the Warren Buffett value screen. Every number here is documented in buffett_formula.md with its rationale and source. Adjust freely - the engine reads all thresholds from this file.

valuation._discount_rate_note: Required rate of return. Buffett discounts owner earnings at the long-term US Treasury yield; most practitioners floor it near 9-10% to stay conservative. Lower this toward the current 10y Treasury (~0.043) for a more Buffett-literal model.
valuation._growth_cap_note: Never extrapolate >10%/yr for a decade. High growth mean-reverts; Buffett prizes predictability over optimism.
valuation._default_growth_note: Used when historical EPS growth is unavailable.
valuation._graham_aaa_yield_note: Current AAA corporate bond yield used in the bond-adjusted Graham formula.

_quality_gates_note: Quality pillar = 60 points. 'partial' awards half points when the metric clears the looser bar but misses the strict one. net_debt_to_ebitda and interest_coverage use a net-cash override in code (a company with no net debt automatically passes).
_core_gates_note: Gates that MUST pass (strict) for a Strong Candidate verdict, regardless of total score.
_valuation_scoring_note: Valuation pillar = 40 points. Margin-of-safety scaled 0->30 as MOS goes 0%->target. P/E scaled 10->0 as P/E goes pe_full->pe_zero (don't overpay even for quality).
_margin_of_safety_target_note: Graham's principle: buy at >=25% below intrinsic value.
_expected_return_note: Forward-return estimates assume price converges to the DCF intrinsic value over horizon_years, while intrinsic value itself compounds at the discount rate. expected_return_annual = (1+discount_rate) * (intrinsic/price)^(1/horizon_years) - 1. years_to_target = ln(1+target_gain)/ln(1+expected_return_annual). These are MODEL ESTIMATES, not predictions of price or timing.
